Grandview Yard Condo Offered $338,000
1200 Grandview Ave #12, Columbus, OH 43212
2 BR, 2 BA, 1,280 sq ft. Dues $365 per month; one-time capitalization fee of $1,000 payable by purchaser. Tax: $5,900 annually (half-year $2,950). Insurance: $72 monthly. Seller concession of 2% of sales price. Lender credit 0.5% not included. Buyer pays: title search $350, settlement fee $600, attorney review $500, courier $45. Earnest money 1% of price. 14-day inspection period. Seller prefers closing on or before February 12, 2027.
